current_answer: AI’s commercial expansion is real. Its ownership prices still depend on substantial future cash that has not been demonstrated across the whole build-out. The evidence supports commercial substance with material, unevenly supported ownership expectations—not a uniformly fictitious economy or a verdict that every AI share is a bubble.
summary: Real customer value. Demanding ownership prices. The question is what remains after investment, replacement and funding.
uncertainty: Independent customers renewing at nonsubsidized prices, durable cash margins after full costs, and successful repayment and replacement across delivered investment cohorts would weaken the concern. Weak retention, greater dependence on fresh financing and poorer collateral recovery together would strengthen it—even if technical performance keeps improving.
freshness_note: Ownership-price investigation dated 26 September; underlying price, financial and earlier research observations retain their own dates.
